notes.title: Patch 0.5.4 -- Balance and Clarity Update
notes.notes: This patch delivers a number of quality-of-life improvements, gameplay changes, UI improvements, crucial bug fixes, and new content to the game! Check out the full patch notes here.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.3 -- Variety Update!
notes.notes:
Patch 0.5.3 brings a host of changes including new items, characters, and new ways to tweak the game according to your tastes! Alongside this patch comes new artwork, balance changes, and visual improvements.

To read the full patch notes, click here.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.2 -- Streamlining Update
notes.notes:
This patch contains a bunch of changes including new content, improvements to AI, gameplay tweaks, and balance adjustments!

Check out the full patch notes here.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.1 -- AI Update
notes.notes:
Today, a patch goes live that will add the ability to play with AI-controlled players, enabling singleplayer games! 

Whether you need to fill out a lobby with additional players or test out new strategies in a solo game, the choice is yours; check out the full patch notes here.
